name: Benjamin Harrison

birth.place: North Bend, Ohio (farm on the Ohio River)

bioAdditions: Path verified: John Tuthill (1635) -> Henry (1665) -> Henry (1690) -> Henry (d. 1793) -> Anna Tuthill -> Anna Symmes Harrison -> John Scott Harrison -> Benjamin, 7 generations: 6th cousin 5 times removed (Akerly S2; Wikipedia S1 for the Harrison generations). Second route via William Wells (Bethia Wells -> Bethia Horton -> Henry 1690 ...), 8 generations: 7th cousin 4 times removed. Conditional third route via Barnabas Horton (7C5R, twice) if the Rachel Browne line holds. His Virginia Harrison ancestry is not John's.

confidenceRecommendation.justification: Collateral path fully sourced; John's own James -> John Tuthill link remains the only weak point.

sources.supports: Dates; grandson of W. H. Harrison

sources.citation: Lucy D. Akerly, The Tuthill Family of Tharston, Norfolk Co., England, and Southold, Suffolk Co., New York (1898) (archive.org full text), pp. 7-10
sources.supports: Tuthill line to Anna Symmes; 'grandmother of President Benjamin Harrison'
